title: Sanaballat
summary: Raleigh names Sanaballat in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Sanaballat, also printed Sanabula, the satrap of Samaria who revolted from Darius to Alexander. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VII, §. III, subsection III, sig. 220b
